name: goal_decomposition
description: Decomposes a high-level goal (CapabilityDemand) into an ordered ExecutionPlan: a tree of atomic steps, each tagged with the capability that should serve it and a gate that must pass before the next step. Deterministic for the same demand + same installed capabilities (Constitution Principle 4); optional inputs from the brain (project knowledge) make steps smarter but the plan shape stays reproducible without them.

inputs.name: project_context
inputs.description: Brain snapshot from AIOS-MODULE-000005 (file index, deps graph). Empty when brain not installed.

outputs.name: plan
outputs.description: ExecutionPlan { plan_id: AIOS-PLAN-NNNNNN, goal, steps: [{ step_id, capability_id, inputs, gate, depends_on[], rollback_ref }], estimated_duration_min, required_capabilities[] }

side_effects: Emits AIOS-EVENT-000020 plan_drafted and AIOS-EVENT-000021 plan_approved|plan_rejected

error_codes.message: Goal cannot be decomposed into atomic steps with current capabilities.
error_codes.recovery: Per Law 12: surface what is missing, request minimal clarification; never fabricate steps.

error_codes.message: Plan requires a capability no installed module provides.
error_codes.recovery: Mark the step as blocked; list the pack/module that provides the capability; continue planning the resolvable parts.
Break the cycle by minimum-feedback-edge removal; log which edge was cut.

examples: goal 'add email+oauth auth' -> steps=[stage_design, stage_migration, stage_impl_email, stage_impl_oauth, stage_tests, stage_review] each with gate + rollback_ref
